also: bang your head against a wall

terms.gloss: (to kick with) the heels against the goad: to make things worse by resisting
evidence: Ter. Ph. 77–78: Namque īnscītia est, adversum stimulum calcēs.
Lewis & Short s.v. stimulus: “kick against the pricks”
terms.comment: The verb is left out in Terence. Plautus puts it another way: sī stimulōs pugnīs caedis, manibus plūs dolet (Truc. 4.2.55, Lewis & Short).

phrases.latin: Namque īnscītia est, adversum stimulum calcēs.
phrases.english: For it is folly to kick against the goad.
